summary: Iter 9 verified end-to-end: mileage-mode (workflow/segment) profile selector + PaperSheet privacy rule + TripRecap celebration modal all pass. 9/9 new pytest cases green; 24/24 iter7+iter8 regression still green (33/33 backend total). E2E Playwright covered: workflow-mode trip form, PaperSheet has NO 'Total Miles' text, segment-mode auto-sum (142+87+122=351 mi), Finish&Export -> TripRecap modal opens with correct values (career 999,700 -> 1,000,051, next milestone 2M Miles @ 50%, 1M Miles badge unlocked).

minor.issue: Spec says 'non-finished or missing session returns 404' but the implementation only 404s on missing — it returns 200 for an active (not-yet-finished) session. Currently benign because the UI only opens the recap AFTER /finish succeeded, but the contract as written in the request is slightly looser than the server enforces. Consider also rejecting status!='finished' with 404 for defense-in-depth.

backend_iter9.TestFinishSegmentAutoSum::test_workflow_: PASS (workflow ignores segment_miles, requires explicit total)
backend_iter9.TestTripRecap::test_recap_shape_with_mil: PASS (career_before=999700, career_after=1000051, next_milestone=2M Miles, new_badges includes miles_1000000 label='1M Miles')

action_items: OPTIONAL: tighten GET /api/trip-sessions/{id}/recap to 404 when status != 'finished' — the spec asks for non-finished+missing => 404 but server only 404s on missing. No user-facing impact today since UI only shows recap after /finish.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is now 888 lines — consider splitting (trips, recap, achievements, stats, auth) into sub-routers. This was already flagged in iter 8 at 747 lines; the threshold has grown.

recap endpoint uses `miles_before = miles_total_in_app - this_trip_miles` which implicitly assumes THIS trip is finished and included in the sum; returning a recap on a non-finished trip would report career_before == baseline + miles_total_in_app (and career_after equal to career_before), which is misleading. Reinforces the 404 tightening recommendation.

FinishExportDialog: TripRecap state `recapSessionId` is kept on the dialog even after onOpenChange — fine, but worth verifying no stale recap can open for a previous trip after a second Finish&Export in the same mount.

Created 1 active trip-session via POST /api/trip-sessions (session_id=ts_0af3fc7b5971, rows[0..2].segment_miles=142,87,122). Finished via UI -> auto-summed to total_trip_miles=351. context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 9 is fully green. Key learnings for next iter: (1) mileage_mode UI branching is purely from profile.mileage_mode; set it via POST /api/profile before hitting /dashboard. (2) Segment rows are only active in the UI one-at-a-time (only the selected stop tab renders the segment input), so when writing UI tests for more than one row use PUT /api/trip-sessions/{id} to seed all rows at once then reload. (3) FinishExportDialog requires ~12-15s for its 0->100% animation before TripRecap opens; the progress bar animates across 4 phases. (4) POST /api/profile REQUIRES full_name — remember to include it in any profile payload. (5) Recap endpoint does not currently 404 on non-finished sessions (only on missing). Flagged as minor.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures. Initial test failure in iter9 test file was due to missing 'full_name' in POST /api/profile payloads (server enforces it as a required Pydantic field); fixed by including full_name in all profile payloads.
